message.content: I sort the laundry bags first, then fold the clean towels. There's a lot of carts to put away too. Sometimes I hear a voice, but I just keep working. It doesn't really bother me too much, as long as I'm in a routine. I don't know why it happens, but it's been going on for a while now. My sister noticed it first, so she suggested I come here. I try not to think about it too much. The job is pretty straightforward, just repetitive stuff. I don't have any problems with the coworkers, really. It's a quiet place, which helps me focus.
